snapshot.text: Fragmented system dominated by private hospitals, weakened by years of economic crisis. Renewed war in 2026 has hit health care hard: the minister reports 116 health workers killed since 2 March, with public hospitals in the south carrying the burden.

priorities.title: Protecting health workers
priorities.text: The minister calls for firm action to protect health workers and medical facilities.

priorities.title: Care for displaced people
priorities.text: Medical coverage was announced for displaced residents of southern border villages.
